summary: Backend + mobile-web frontend regression testing completed for Tile Orders restore workflow. Required tabs, dispatch list route, release/move/dispatch APIs, dispatch/chalan generation, PDF validity, persistence checks, and contract guard all passed. One frontend console regression was found (duplicate React key in Dispatch List rows).

minor.issue: Observed one transient 30s read-timeout during new E2E pytest setup; retry succeeded and all workflow assertions passed.

ui_bugs.component: Tile Orders Dispatch List row rendering
ui_bugs.issue: Console shows duplicate React key warning when two rows share dispatch_id + chalan_id + tile_name; this can cause row identity/render instability.

action_items: Fix Dispatch List row key generation in frontend/app/(admin)/tiles/orders/index.tsx to guarantee uniqueness per rendered line item (not only dispatch_id/chalan_id/tile_name).
(Optional hardening) Add testID attributes to non-instrumented interactive rows in brand detail pages to improve deterministic mobile automation coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(admin)/tiles/orders/index.tsx uses key `${row.dispatch_id}-${row.chalan_id}-${row.tile_name}`; duplicate tile names within same dispatch/chalan produce duplicate keys and console errors.
New workflow API contracts and CI route contract guard are intact; no missing endpoint bindings found in frontend/src/api/tileOrders.ts and frontend/scripts/verify-tile-orders-contract.mjs.
seed_data_creation: Created one live TEST_ quotation/order via API flow in regression test: project_name TEST_restore_<uuid>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use owner credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tile_orders_restore_workflow_regression.py -v with EXPO_BACKEND_URL set to preview domain, then mobile UI check for Dispatch List after key fix.
rca_of_issue: Duplicate Dispatch List console error RCA: React key collision in map rendering. Repro: open /tiles/orders -> Dispatch List with dataset containing repeated tile_name lines under same dispatch/chalan. Console logs emit 'Encountered two children with the same key'. Mitigation: include a guaranteed unique discriminator (line index or po_item_id from backend row payload) in row key.
